name: FlatDarkCorrection
label: Flat/Dark Field Correction
description: Correct raw X-ray projections with flat-field (open beam) and dark-field (beam off) images: T = (I - dark) / (flat - dark). Each of the flat and dark inputs may be a single image or a stack of images, which are averaged. The dark field is optional (0 when not connected). With 'Convert to line integrals' on, the result is -ln(T), which is what reconstruction expects. Pixels where flat <= dark are treated as dead and come out as no attenuation.

parameters.name: flat
parameters.label: Flat Field
parameters.description: Open-beam image(s) with the same detector size as the projections.

parameters.name: dark
parameters.label: Dark Field
parameters.description: Beam-off image(s) with the same detector size as the projections. Optional: leave it unconnected if the detector has no dark offset, and 0 is used.

parameters.name: flat_mode
parameters.label: Flat Fields
parameters.description: Average: one flat field, the mean of all flat frames. Interpolate: the beam drifts during long scans, so each projection gets a flat interpolated between the flat frames taken before, during and after the scan, by when they were taken (from the file, or from Flats Taken Before the Scan).

parameters.name: flats_before
parameters.label: Flats Taken Before the Scan (0 = from the file)
parameters.description: For files that do not record when each frame was taken: how many of the flat frames (at the start of the flat stack) were taken before the scan; the rest count as taken after it.

parameters.name: min_transmission
parameters.label: Minimum Transmission
parameters.description: Transmission is clipped to at least this before the log, so photon-starved pixels give large finite values instead of infinity.
